Prashant's Birthday Card

Dear Prashant,

Happiest Birthday Jaanu ♥

I honestly don’t know where to start, but I really wanted to write something for you because I have a lot of things I want to say. It’s crazy how we met on 24th August, and I had no idea then that you would become someone I’d look forward to talking to every day. And then we finally met on 9th September in rajiv chowk (which was the destiny ig). I know it hasn’t been that long, but somehow you’ve become a person who means a lot to me.

There are so many little things about you that I genuinely love and appreciate. The way you check up on me, the way you somehow figure out when I’m not in a good mood, even when I don’t really say anything, and how you always make sure I’m okay. I love how caring you are, how you make me laugh and, of course, how you never miss a chance to compliment me. You probably don’t realise it, but these little things make me really happy. Sometimes even a simple message from you can make my day a little better.

I know we haven’t really got to meet as much as we would have liked to, and honestly, I wish we had more time together. But one thing I really appreciate is that you’ve never made me feel bad about it. You’ve never made it seem like the distance or the lack of meetings changes anything, and I hope you know that I appreciate that more than I can put into words. Even though we haven’t spent that much time together in person, I’m glad that I’ve got to know you the way I have.

I really wish I could have met you today. I wish I could have wished you in person, given you a hug and actually handed you a birthday gift. It makes me a little sad that I couldn’t do that, because I genuinely wanted to make your birthday special. I just wanted you to have something that you could read whenever you feel like it.

I hope this year is really, really good to you. I hope you get everything you’ve been wishing for, achieve all the things you work so hard for and have so many reasons to be happy. I hope you always have people around you who care for you just as much as you care for them. And on days when things aren’t going your way, I hope you remember that those days don’t last forever.

I’m genuinely glad we met, and I’m glad that out of all the people, I got to know you. I don’t really know what to call what we have, and I don’t think I need to put a name to it right now. I just know that you’ve become someone special to me, and I’m really happy that you’re a part of my life.

Happy Birthday once again. loveee you so so much mwah ♥♥

With all my love,Kavya
